admission.justification: Avoids destroying title-prefix reach for standalone tasks or matching invisible internal master-child identifiers.

applicability: Typeahead on Operations task rows in the real ListBox.
conditions: Numbered master-child labels match their displayed short-id then title.
Sprints, masters and standalone tasks retain title-prefix matching.
exclusions: Matching the internal full master-child id instead of visible text.
Treating a standalone separate id cell as the typeahead label.

evidence: dashboard/src/panels/lifecycle-list/hierarchy.test.tsx: "finds a row by typing what it shows" and "still finds a task that stands alone by typing its title"; fault runs typing-standalone and typing-visible-id (notes/reports/worker/8c3d5f2a-6e74-4b90-c2f1-144000000a01/role-launch/evidence-L144-A2/103-fault-runs-final.log); comparison page, difference "Typing to find a row". Repair of the Reviewer's finding L144-R1-02.

statement: Typing with the list in the keyboard's focus finds a row by the beginning of what the row shows: a task numbered in its master by its short id and then its title, and no longer by the whole id inside its master; a row whose text is its title alone (a sprint, a master, a task that stands alone) by that title, as before the rebuild.
